title: GitHub Advanced Security in the AI SDLC
description: Why AI-accelerated software delivery needs integrated application security, how GHAS compounds existing GitHub and Copilot investments, and what changed across seven months of releases.
learningObjectives: Explain why AI-assisted development increases the need for continuous security controls.
Map GitHub Advanced Security capabilities across the AI software development lifecycle.
Show how GHAS reuses GitHub repositories, pull requests, Actions, policies, Copilot, and runtime integrations.
Demonstrate developer security review, pull-request scanning, and Autofix remediation flows.
Prioritize adoption using the latest application-security releases and a practical rollout plan.
